title: Ashbury Rewards Brand Standards Schedule: Welcome Brand Supplement
content:
**Ashbury Rewards — welcome brand supplement.** A stay at an Ashbury Reserve or Ashbury Resort & Spa hotel carries a welcome brand supplement of five hundred points, a stay at an Ashbury Grand or Ashbury Hotel carries two hundred and fifty points, and a stay at an Ashbury Express or Ashbury Inn & Suites hotel carries none. The supplement forms part of the welcome points of the stay; when the tier's welcome amount for the stay is zero, the stay receives no welcome points and carries no supplement. The brand is the hotel brand recorded on the stay's Room Reservations record.

| Brand of the stay | Welcome brand supplement |
|---|---|
| Ashbury Reserve | 500 points |
| Ashbury Resort & Spa | 500 points |
| Ashbury Grand | 250 points |
| Ashbury Hotel | 250 points |
| Ashbury Inn & Suites | None |
| Ashbury Express | None |

The supplement is carried once per stay and does not depend on the nights stayed.

**Illustration (hypothetical stays).** A Platinum Elite member's stay at an Ashbury Reserve carries 500 points of brand supplement. A Silver Elite member's stay at the same hotel receives no welcome points, because the Silver Elite welcome amount is zero, and therefore no supplement.
